item.title: What's New in RDF.rb 0.3.0
item.description: RDF.rb 0.3.0 adds transactions, basic graph pattern queries, and fast parsers and serializers for RDFa, Notation3, Turtle, and RDF/XML.

item.title: Parsing and Serializing RDF Data with Ruby
item.description: A tutorial on parsing and serializing the various RDF-based Linked Data formats with the RDF.rb library for Ruby.

item.title: RDF.rb: A Public-Domain RDF Library for Ruby
item.description: Introducing the first release of RDF.rb, its design philosophy and object model, with a tutorial on using its core classes.
